card.name: Start of a number after a quantity word
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a multi-digit number, mostly right after words like over, to, exceed or into. It is mostly seen in dose amounts, durations and counts.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank token after a preposition or quantity word, just before a number begins.
